About Us

Your Pet's Home Away From Home 🏡

Happy Paws & Pixels is a community-driven pet hostel that provides safe, loving, and professional care for your dogs and cats while you're away. Founded as part of a College Community Engagement Project, our mission is to combine compassionate animal care with smart digital management.

Our facility is staffed by dedicated volunteers and supervised by experienced pet care coordinators. We maintain detailed records for every pet, ensuring transparent communication with owners at all times.

Our Services

Everything Your Pet Needs 🐕🐈

From comfortable boarding to daily walks, we provide comprehensive care for your beloved companions.

🛏️

Comfortable Boarding

Cozy, clean, and spacious accommodation with separate areas for dogs and cats. Bedding and climate control included.

🍽️

Nutritious Feeding

Scheduled meals with quality pet food. Special dietary requirements accommodated with prior notice.

🚶

Daily Exercise & Walks

Regular exercise and playtime managed by trained volunteers. Dogs receive daily outdoor walks.

🛁

Grooming Services

Basic grooming, brushing, and hygiene care to keep your pet clean and comfortable during their stay.

🏥

Health Monitoring

Daily health checks and wellness monitoring. Emergency veterinary referral services available.

📸

Pet Updates

Regular photo updates and welfare reports shared with pet owners to provide peace of mind.

🎮

Enrichment Activities

Socialization, play sessions, and mental stimulation activities tailored to each pet's personality.

🌙

Overnight Care

24-hour supervision for overnight stays. Pets are never left unattended during the night.

📋

Digital Record Keeping

Fully digital registration, stay management, and consent forms for a hassle-free experience.

Rules & Regulations

Hostel Guidelines 📜

Please read and familiarize yourself with our hostel rules to ensure a safe and happy experience for all pets.

🐕 Pet Admission Requirements

  • All pets must be up-to-date with vaccinations before check-in.
  • Pets must be free from contagious diseases or parasites.
  • Dogs must be dewormed and flea-treated prior to admission.
  • Cats must be neutered or spayed (recommended).
  • Pets showing signs of illness will not be admitted.

👤 Owner Responsibilities

  • Owners must provide accurate emergency contact information.
  • Owners must inform staff of any special dietary or medical needs.
  • Owners must provide pet food if preferred diet is required.
  • All medications must be labelled and accompanied by instructions.
  • Owners must sign the digital consent form before check-in.

🏨 Stay & Accommodation Rules

  • Check-in time: [As per schedule] — Edit with actual times.
  • Check-out time: [As per schedule] — Edit with actual times.
  • Late pick-up may incur additional charges.
  • The hostel reserves the right to seek veterinary care in emergencies.
  • Hostel is not responsible for pre-existing health conditions.

🚫 Prohibited Items & Behaviour

  • No aggressive or dangerous animals without prior approval.
  • Owners may not visit without prior appointment during peak hours.
  • No choke chains, prong collars, or punishment-based equipment.
  • Personal toys must be labelled to prevent loss.
  • Noise disturbances or damage to property may result in early check-out.

Got Questions?

Frequently Asked Questions ❓

Find answers to the most common questions about our pet hostel services.

We currently accept dogs and cats of all breeds and sizes. For other animals, please contact us in advance to discuss accommodation options. All pets must be healthy, vaccinated, and free from contagious conditions.
You can register your pet using our online Pet Registration form available on this website. Simply fill in your pet's details, your contact information, and any special care requirements. After registration, you'll be guided to complete the digital consent form.
Dogs must be vaccinated against Rabies, Distemper, Parvovirus, and Leptospirosis. Cats must be vaccinated against Feline Herpesvirus, Calicivirus, and Panleukopenia. Proof of vaccination must be presented at check-in.
Yes! We encourage owners to bring their pet's regular food, especially if they have dietary requirements or sensitivities. You may also bring a familiar blanket or toy to help your pet feel at home. Please label all personal items clearly.
If your pet shows signs of illness, our staff will contact you immediately. If required and the owner cannot be reached, we will contact the designated emergency contact. In urgent situations, we will take the pet to our partner veterinary clinic, and all costs will be borne by the owner.
You can register as a volunteer using the Volunteer Registration form on our website. Select your preferred activities and availability. Our volunteer coordinator will review your application and get in touch with you within a few days.
Yes, the digital consent form is mandatory for all pet stays. It covers hostel rules, owner responsibilities, and emergency procedures. Consent must be completed before your pet can check in. You can access and sign the consent form on the Consent & Agreement page.
Visits are allowed by prior appointment during non-peak hours. Please contact us at least 24 hours in advance to schedule a visit. We also provide regular photo and video updates so you can see how your pet is doing!
